Looking at the qlang documentation, I'll work through each task systematically, understanding the key concepts:
- Pipelines combine steps with `|`
- `*` applies operations to each element
- Modifiers are quotes like `~(...)` or names like `~name`
- Path notation: `/k` reads keys, `/0` reads elements
- Commands take the piped value as implicit subject

R1: filter ~(/active) | filter ~(at :address | ne null) | filter ~(/address | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") | * /name | sort

R2: * /age | filter ~(type | eq :number) | avg | round 2

R3: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~(/customer) | * (/ * /items | flat | * ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum | round 2)

R4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(/assignee | at :login | coalesce "unassigned") | * count

R5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * /number

R6: [/dependencies /devDependencies] | * (filter ~(/startsWith "^") | keys) | flat | sort | distinct

R7: split "\n" | * (split " " | {path: /2, status: /3 | parseJson}) | filter ~(/status | gte 500) | * /path | distinct | sort

R8: split "\n" | * (split " " | {method: /1, duration: /4 | take ~(count | sub 2) | parseJson}) | filter ~(/method | eq "GET") | * /duration | avg | round 0

R9: split "\n" | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | * ({dept: /1, salary: /2 | parseJson}) | groupBy ~(/dept) | * (avg | round 1)

R10: split "\n" | drop 1 | * (split "," | /3 | split ";" | * lower | filter ~(ne "")) | flat | distinct | sort

R11: split "\n" | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | * (split "=" | {key: /0 | trim | drop 3 | lower, value: (drop 1 | join "=") | trim}) | filter ~(/key | ne "") | groupBy ~(/key) | * (first | /value)

R12: /services | entries | filter ~(/value | at :enabled | eq true) | * ~({name: /key, url: (/value | /protocol | append "://" | append (/value | /host) | append ":" | append (/value | /port | coalesce 80 | print))}) | sort ~([/name])

R13: {total: (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") | * (/meta | at :amount | coalesce 0) | sum | round 2), users: (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") | * /user | distinct | count), hasRefund: (/ | * /type | * lower | filter ~(eq "refund") | count | gt 0)}

R14: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","Elder","cherry","fig","Apple"] | * lower | groupBy ~ (/) | filter ~(count | gt 1) | keys | sort
